subject: Invoice delivery and AP handoff: preferred sender & copies for NeonApps
messages:
From: Hannah Price <ap@neonapps.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@neonapps.com
Date: 2028-01-11T09:03:00-08:00
Subject: AP onboarding — invoice format & delivery options

Hi Connor,

We're getting ready to onboard Redwood for AR processing. Can you confirm the available invoice delivery methods and who is the sender on the invoice? Our AP team prefers portal push with auto-PDF copies to ap@neonapps.com, but we need a fallback to email if the portal delivery fails. Also, we need VAT evidence attached for EU entities.

Specific asks:
- Which email will appear as the invoice sender?
- Can you send both portal and email copies?
- Do you support SFTP or webhook push if we want a machine-readable feed?

Attaching our AP spec for reference.

Thanks,
Hannah Price
AP Manager, NeonApps
AP: ap@neonapps.com

Attachments: ap-invoice-specs.pdf (PDF)

From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Price <ap@neonapps.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-01-11T10:27:00-08:00
Subject: Re: AP onboarding — invoice format & delivery options

Hi Hannah — thanks for the spec, got it. Short answers below and then looping in Billing/Finance for configuration: 

- Invoice sender: default is billing@redwood.com (PDFs show Redwood Inference as the sender). If NeonApps requires a different remit-from, we can set a custom "Bill From" display name but legal remit will still be Redwood Inference.
- Delivery options we support today: 1) Portal-native delivery (preferred) with automatic PDF copies to one or more email addresses, 2) SMTP/email as a fallback, 3) SFTP drop or webhook/push for machine-integration.
- VAT evidence: we can attach VAT summary files per invoice and also include a separate VAT evidence workbook on monthly bundles.

Looping in Marissa (billing lead) and Ben (finops) to confirm the recommended default and any steps on our side to enable portal+email copies.

Next step suggestions: Marissa, can you confirm whether we should default NeonApps to "Portal primary + email mirror to ap@neonapps.com" and whether we should enable monthly VAT workbook? Also, Ben, do we need a deal-level config (NEON-2031) to ensure PDFs are CC'd automatically?

Cheers,
Connor
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-01-12T08:41:00-08:00
Subject: Re: AP onboarding — invoice format & delivery options

Connor / Ben — quick operational guidance:

I recommend the following (works for most enterprise AP teams):
1) Set NeonApps to Portal-first delivery. Portal push sends the invoice into their account in our portal immediately.
2) Configure an email mirror to ap@neonapps.com (and procurement@neonapps.com if they want visibility). The mirror is a PDF attach in the email; subject line includes invoice number and PO reference.
3) Enable monthly VAT workbook attachment (neonapps-vat-evidence-requirements.xlsx) on the first invoice of the month and on request for ad-hoc audit bundles.
4) As a technical fallback, enable SFTP drop for nightly bundles. We have an SFTP endpoint template we can provide.

From a sender perspective: the visible sender will be "billing@redwood.com". If NeonApps needs the remit-from to match their AP rules (e.g., Bill From: Redwood Inference Ltd for EU invoices), we will set the entity-level remit name and include EU VAT number on the invoice header. This requires mapping the correct legal entity in our billing system — Laura can run that mapping.

Ben — please confirm whether enabling email mirror requires a config change in Billing console or a manual entitiy mapping on the account. If it needs a deal-level flag, we should add NEON-2031 to the rollout task.

Marissa Cole
Head of Billing Operations, Redwood Inference

Attachments: sample-invoice.pdf (PDF)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-01-12T11:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: AP onboarding — invoice format & delivery options

Marissa — confirmed. Operational notes: 
- Email mirror is a per-account flag we toggle in the Billing Console; once set it auto-CCs configured addresses with a PDF attachment. I will enable it for NeonApps after Connor confirms the exact emails.
- SFTP/webhook: both supported. For NeonApps I'd prefer webhook push (lower ops) — we can provide a signed webhook with retry + poison-queue logic. SFTP is fine if their security team prefers it.
- VAT evidence: monthly workbook must be attached manually the first month until we automate (work item assigned to Billing team). I'll add NEON-2031 to our queue and estimate 2 weeks for automation.

Connor — can you confirm the final email list to CC? Hannah asked for ap@neonapps.com and procurement@neonapps.com — any internal copies needed?

Ben
Director, Finance Ops

From: Hannah Price <ap@neonapps.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@neonapps.com, Olaf Jensen <olaf.jensen@neonapps.com>
Date: 2028-01-15T16:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: AP onboarding — invoice format & delivery options

Hi Connor — thanks for the clarity and to your team for the plan. We confirm: 
- Portal-first delivery with email mirror to ap@neonapps.com and procurement@neonapps.com.
- Please set the remit-from name to "Redwood Inference Ltd" for our EU invoices and include the Redwood EU VAT number on those invoices.
- We'll accept webhook push for machine ingestion; please send the webhook spec and a test endpoint. If that is delayed, we'll fall back to SFTP.
- VAT evidence: please attach the monthly workbook on the first invoice of each month; we may request ad-hoc bundles for audits.

Next steps: Connor, if you can confirm NEON-2031 is flagged for the email mirror and that Marissa/Ben will send the webhook spec and SFTP template, we'll schedule a short tech handshake (30 min) with our AP integrator next week.

Best,
Hannah
AP Manager, NeonApps
